title: Scheduled Fourier estimator failure bound
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube, let $S$ be a subset of its coordinates, and let $\varepsilon,\delta\in\mathbb Q$ satisfy $0<\varepsilon,\delta\le 1/2$. The probability that the scheduled empirical Fourier coefficient differs from the Fourier coefficient of $f$ on $S$ by at least $\varepsilon$ is at most $\delta$; the error and threshold are measured as real numbers.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
$S$ is a subset of the coordinates
